description: Golden parity for the PURE convert kernel convertMoneyWithRate(amount, from, to, rate) in @tims/shared (Slice 11c). The live packages/api/src/lib/currency.ts convertMoney delegates to it (behavior-preserving); the C# Tims.Domain.Compensation.CompensationKernels.ConvertMoney mirrors it. Asserted IDENTICALLY by the REAL TS export (tests/currency/convert-money-fixtures.test.ts) and the C# unit test (Tims.UnitTests). FIXED rates only — the live frankfurter fetch is NEVER fixtured (NEVER golden-parity a live rate). Pins: originalAmount = Number(amount)||0; amount = roundMoney(originalAmount*rate) with the Number.EPSILON half-up bias (1.005 -> 1.01, NOT banker's 1.00); from/to pass through verbatim (the CALLER normalizes).

cases.name: identity rate=1 same currency: 123.45 COP -> 123.45 COP
EPSILON half-up bias: 1.005 USD @ rate 1 -> 1.01 (NOT banker's 1.00)
zero amount coerces to 0 (Number(amount)||0), still shaped
three-decimal input rounds to 2: 333.333 USD @ rate 1 -> 333.33
